source:
@@U00207@@
Over there? Do you see? Those college boys? They can have the pick of the lot, but all they chase is servant girls!

@@U00209@@
(To the FIRST.)

@@U00210@@
What’s the rush? Take a look behind us. See those two, all dressed up and out for a stroll? And one lives next door! O God, look at her! Isn't she something! They may look shy, but they'll come around.

@@U00212@@
No way. I like my game wild. Get a move on, we'll lose the scent. They know more than sweeping floors. On Sunday those tiny hands go roaming.

@@U00214@@
No, I don't like the new mayor, no! Arrogant fellow if you ask me! Gets worse every day! And what’ he ever done? Thinks he can dictate our every move! And raises taxes!

@@U00216@@
(Sings.)

@@U00217@@
Fine gentlemen and lovely ladies, Rosy-cheeked in such fine dress, Look at me and show some pity, Be kind to me in my distress. Let me not grind away for nothing. Only the one that gives is gay. A day when all the world is joyous Should be for me a harvest day!
translation:
@@U00207@@
在那儿？你看到了吗？那些大学男生？他们可以挑，但他们追的只是丫鬟！

@@U00209@@
（到第一个。）

@@U00210@@
急什么？看看我们身后。看到那两个人，盛装打扮出来散步了吗？还有一个人住在隔壁！天啊，看看她！她不是有什么东西吗！他们可能看起来很害羞，但他们会改变态度。

@@U00212@@
没办法。我喜欢我的游戏狂野。继续前进，我们就会失去气味。他们知道的不仅仅是扫地。周日，那些小手就去漫游了。

@@U00214@@
不，我不喜欢新市长，不！如果你问我的话，我就是个傲慢的家伙！一天天变得更糟！他做过什么？认为他可以决定我们的一举一动！并且加税！

@@U00216@@
（唱歌。）

@@U00217@@
优雅的绅士和可爱的女士，穿着如此精美的衣服，脸颊红润，看着我，表现出一些怜悯，在我的痛苦中善待我。让我不要无缘无故地苦苦挣扎。只有给予的人才是同性恋。全世界都欢乐的一天，对我来说应该是一个收获的日子！
